minutes.headline: Planning Board approved two ANR plans and a common driveway, and continued the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal hearing to Feb 10.
minutes.summary: The board approved ANR plans for 871/915 Northfield Road and 41/47 Reservoir Road, and a common driveway with a culvert load condition. It continued the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal and stormwater hearing to February 10 over concerns about the ACEC, phasing and screening. It also discussed the Brooks House lot, scenic road protection, the earth removal bylaw threshold, master plan projections, the stormwater bylaw and a senior housing idea.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal and stormwater hearing to February 10.
The board approved the ANR plan for 871 and 915 Northfield Road.
The board approved the ANR plan for 41 and 47 Reservoir Road as presented.
A common driveway for 41 and 47 Reservoir Road was moved with a condition that the culvert be rated and certified for heavy loads; the vote was not audible.
The board leaned toward taking an earth removal bylaw to Town Meeting as two articles, without fill, and toward a 1,500 cubic yard threshold; no vote was taken.

why_it_matters: Earth removal rules and the stormwater bylaw decide how gravel and soil removal sites are limited, screened and drained, which affects neighbors of such sites and could reach residents as Town Meeting articles.
The Brooks House lot and scenic road decisions are at an early stage; a joint meeting with the Board of Selectmen would be the next step on the lot lines.
watch_next: February 10 Planning Board meeting: earth removal discussion, the 1325 Mass Ave hearing continuation and the stormwater bylaw.
A joint meeting with the Board of Selectmen on the Brooks House lot lines, requested by letter from planning staff.
